title: SAP Material Master
description: Material master data extracted from SAP MARA (client level) and MARC (plant level). One row per material/plant combination.

material_type.description: MARA-MTART. SAP material type. Programme scope is stores and spares; fixtures use SPARE, CONSUMABLE, RAW_MAT.

reorder_point.description: MARC-MINBE. Reorder point quantity. May be null when not maintained.

safety_stock.description: MARC-EISBE. Safety stock quantity. May be null when not maintained.

lead_time_days.description: MARC-PLIFZ planned delivery time in days. May be null when not maintained.

criticality_flag.description: Criticality classification (e.g. VITAL, INSURANCE, ESSENTIAL, DESIRABLE). Sourced from a Z-field or classification characteristic.

valuation_price.description: MBEW-VERPR / MBEW-STPRS. Moving average or standard price per base unit.

currency.description: Currency key of the valuation price, e.g. USD, INR, ZAR.
